name: blueprint/red-green-loop
description: TDD enforced by receipts: the failing test runs first (red receipt), the fix runs the same command to green, refactor re-runs it again
recipe: write the failing test -> run it - the red receipt is required before any fix -> fix until the same command is green -> refactor and re-run, then the gate
pitfalls: the red receipt is required - no red, no fix
verify with the SAME command that reproduced
exit code is the verdict, warnings notwithstanding
